## Scope

Describe the mathematical, editorial, verification, or repository change.

## Affected statements

List theorem labels, topics, PDF pages, or statement-index entries.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran `python scripts/repo.py verify --strict`.
- [ ] I updated `ERRATA.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` when required.
- [ ] I updated the priority register when the precedence assessment changed.
- [ ] I did not edit generated files under `build/`, `dist/`, or `verification/results/`.
- [ ] I separated substantive mathematical changes from unrelated formatting changes.

## Evidence

Include proofs, calculations, citations, rendered-page comparisons, or regression results needed to review the change.
